scope: All available 50cm candidates audited; independent wind and forward results exported
missing_stage_policy: Complete curve coefficient from same configuration/position wind Medium relative factor, or nearest available stage; never enter observed data table
partial_stage_policy: Fitted slopes use real samples in the available own-stage SOC span; full reference-stage curves and durations are model calculations, including unobserved edges. Missing entire stages remain separately marked is_modeled.
protocol_differences: Old forward source supports Medium only. Wind fits three stages where observed; missing stages are curve-model completions, not measured labels.
